not_kit_patterns: OPAQUE LOT-TOTAL LINES: T07 (20 lines, Pedro Laurentino/PI) and T23 (9 lines, Ribeira do Piauí/PI). The description reads only 'Descrição do item NNN', qty 1, UND, with estimates of R$821-10,084 each. These are lot values, not unit prices. Treatment: leave them out of the catalogue and of any per-article average. They can be costed only after reading the item text in the edital/TR (links are in tenders.json).

WHOLE-KIT WRAPPER LINES: T15-1 (one 'Kit' line listing liquid soap, shampoo, cologne, wet wipes, brush+comb, tub, bag kit, going-home set, 5-piece cueiro kit, 50 ml alcohol, size-G packaging bag, P nappies pack of 38, and ribbons) and T27-1/T27-2 (boy/girl kit: RN nappies at least 20, 20 L tub 21x40x71, 40x30x15 bag, description truncated). Treatment: break each into catalogue SKUs times quantity, add assembly and packaging, then compare with the kit's awarded price. Read the full component list from the edital first. T15-1 also needs a P pack of 38, which no current SKU covers.

PACKAGING CONSUMABLES: T03-10 'saco plástico' (est R$1.70), T26-15 'saco presente transparente' (R$0.52), T08-9 'saco TNT 35x25' (qty 14 at R$53.11, almost certainly a pack or lot of bags, not one), plus the bag and ribbons inside T15-1. Treatment: not a layette article. Carry it as kit packaging overhead, bid it at cost, and confirm the T08-9 pack quantity.

CUSTOM-PRINTED ITEM: T32-8 nylon maternity bag at least 41x31x18 'personalizada com a logomarca do município' (est R$149). Treatment: out of scope, the same as the Itaquá mochila. It needs a printing route (see data/custom_printing.*). A plain catalogue bag is not a base price.

MOTHER / ADULT GOODS, NOT LAYETTE: T15-8/T15-19 pregnancy sheets, T15-9 blanket, T15-10/T30-19/T35-25 adult bath towel, T15-11 face towel, T15-15 pillows, T15-21 pillowcase, T30-17 maternity nightgown, T30-18 nursing bra, T27-5/T35-23 deodorant, T27-6 adult toothbrush, T35-24 adult shampoo+conditioner, T42-17 adult shampoo 350-400 ml, T42-14 500 ml 'aplicação comercial' liquid soap, T35-21 ordinary sanitary pads, T38-13 double hammock 1.50x2.30 (19 lines). Treatment: the awards are per item, so these can be left unbid. Keep them out of the layette kit cost. If bid, price them as separate adult SKUs. (Post-partum pads stay in the catalogue as a recurring maternity consumable.)

NURSERY / HOUSEHOLD DECOR: T15-3 children's bin, T15-6 decorative pictures, T15-22 large laundry basket. Treatment: exclude. They are not layette, freight is bulky, and they appear in one tender only.

CATALOGUE TEXT DISAGREES WITH THE ITEM ACTUALLY WANTED (T38 Teresina): the item was entered with a generic catalogue (CATMAT) description, and the real item is appended after it. T38-7 mijão → wool mittens; T38-8/9/10 mijão/body pagão → baby shirt P/M/G; T38-12 cretone fabric → piqué wrap; T38-14 romper → wool booties; T38-17 PVC crystal bag → nylon maternity bag; T38-1 'até 25 (kg)' vs appended 'mín. 25 L'. Treatment: price the appended text, and confirm against the TR before bidding, since a fiscal may check either text.

UNIT-BASIS AMBIGUITY (priced as written, flagged): T08-3/T20-5/T08-5 cloth nappy 'Unidade' with pack-like estimates; T11-14 single towel-nappy billed in 'KITS'; T14-5 embroidered nappy 'UN' (pack size not stated); T16-2 'camisetas com pé fechado' (probably trousers); T40-10 shampoo bought by the 'LITRO'; T38-5/T38-6 'Unidade' = pack of 8; T42-1 catalogue text requires a folding stand but the estimate is a plain-tub price. Treatment: read the TR before costing; do not assume the cheaper reading.
SERVICES: no line in the 587 is a service (freight, assembly or personalisation). Kit assembly appears only inside the wrapper lines (T15-1, T27-1/2), and personalisation only in T32-8.

checks.evidence: I re-read the page on 2026-09-25. It shows 'Preço: R$ 61,20' and 'Detalhes: 100%Algodão -- 1Macacão longo -- 1manta (70cmx90cm)', Ref 4069, size RN, with a 'Compra mínima: R$ 300,00' banner. The price and the 2-piece basis are correct. It fails 3 of the 5 SAÍDA lines. (1) T16-9 says 'A MANTA DEVERÁ POSSUIR DIMENSÕES MÍNIMAS DE 0,75 M X 0,75 M', and 70 cm is below that. Every Bloomys set on L4 (Refs 4066/4069/4070/4072/3978/3980/4022, R$61,20-74,30) states a 70x90 manta, so I found no L4 set that passes T16-9. (2) T09-11 asks for macacão + LUVAS + manta bordada in a box, and this set has no mittens. (3) T34-5 asks for macacão + boné + luvas + manta bordada 70x70, and this set has no cap or mittens. It conforms only for the generic T26-8 'KIT MATERNIDADE DE SAIDA' and the T15-1 wrapper. Nearest conforming option for T09-11, read today at the same supplier: L4 'Saída-maternidade Bebelezinha bebe feminino suedine 3pç' Ref 316, R$ 78,00, '100%Algodão -- 1Macacão longo + 1manta + 1par luvas -- embalagem em caixa'. Masculino Refs 320/321 (/326416, /326417) are also R$78,00. Caveats: only size P is offered, and the manta's size and embroidery are not stated. For T16-9 and T34-5 I found nothing conforming. Emilio lists 50 saída sets, all R$113-195 except Karana #14904 (R$59,90, pieces not stated, stock 1) and Feroz 3 peças #5548 (R$77,30, size P), and none states its pieces or manta size. Those lines stay UNVERIFIED above R$78.

I re-read the page today. Price, ListPrice, spotPrice and low/highPrice are all 31.78. The product is 'KIT CASACO LÃ - 4 UNIDADES # 130 - CASTELO', and the description reads 'CASAQUINHO DE LÃ PONTO CONCHA CASTELO 4 PEÇAS Contém: 1 casaco com botões, 1 Gorro, 1 Par de luvinhas, 1 Par de sapatinhos'. It comes in RN in AZUL/BRANCO/PINK/ROSA/VERMELHO; one variant is out of stock and the others show 10 or 100. It conforms to T26-3 'CONJUNTO DE CASAQUINHO TRICÔ': a knitted cardigan with matching pieces. Composition is not on the page. The sibling Castelo #135 casaco page says 100% acrílico, so this set is very likely acrylic, which a knit spec allows. I found no cheaper conforming SET. Emilio searches for casaco/trico/kit casaco turn up only a single Castelo #135 cardigan at R$23,52, a Michele #910 single cardigan at R$29,40 with stock 1, and kits of cap, mittens and booties with no cardigan (Fio de Amor #10032 R$25,58, Papi Mami R$26,74). Note that R$31,78 is above T26-3's homologated R$20,51.

I re-read the page today. Price is 14.58 for 'KIT MEIA BEBÊ CANO MEDIO - 3 PARES # KT.49008.BB - RIKAM' (BRANCO RN and PP, stock 100 each), and 14.58/3 = R$4.86 per pair, which is correct. The page gives the composition as 73% algodão, 24% poliamida, 2% elastano, 1% elastodieno, which passes the at-least-60%-cotton rule. Despite the name, the page says '*soquete micro ... *altura chega no tornozelo', so these are ankle socks. That fits T16-5 (cano curto ou médio) and T39-5 (curtas), but not the 'cano alto' lines T20-7, T08-4, T38-11 and T42-5. It also fails T11-2 (100% algodão). For the cano-alto lines, read today: Pimpolho 'KIT MEIA LISA CANO ALTO - 3 PARES - TAMANHO RN # 0008794' at R$14,22 (R$4,74 per pair), https://www.emilio.com.br/kit-meia-lisa-cano-alto---3-pares---tamanho-rn---0008794---pimpolho/p, plain, but with no composition on the page. A cheaper option read today is Delos 'KIT MEIA ZERO - 6 PARES - TAMANHO RN # 1324' at R$20,56 (R$3,43 per pair), 63% algodão, https://www.emilio.com.br/kit-meia-zero---6-pares---1324---delos--you-/p. But it is 'Colors, cores sortidas', so it is not verified as plain. It could serve lines that do not require 'lisa' (T03-4, T36-7 'cores diversas', T14-6, T30-5), but I did not count it as a refutation of this plain-sock basis.

The listed row checks out: R$14,58 for 3 pairs, RN, 73% cotton, plain white. A cheaper 3-pair RN kit is on the same São Paulo wholesaler, read today: 'KIT MEIA - 3 PARES - TAMANHO RN # 011 - VIVANT' at Price 9.31, variant SORTIDO RN, stock 99999, description 'Kit meia Vivantex com 03 unidades sortidas'. It conforms to the generic lines T06-14 'RN C/3 UN', T10-12 'PCT C/3 PARES' and T09-12 '3 PARES AZUL/BRANCO/ROSA'. Its assorted pattern suits T22 (estampadas) better than the plain Rikam. Caveat: the page states no composition, the same unverified status the original agent accepted for the Pimpolho semaninha. Neither kit meets T32-1 (100% algodão), which remains UNVERIFIED. A cotton-verified alternative is Delos #1324: 6 pairs RN at R$20,56, 63% algodão, which works out to R$10,28 per 3 pairs, but only as a 6-pack.

I re-read the page today. Price, ListPrice and spotPrice are 30.56 for 'KIT MEIA SEMANINHA - MASCULINO - 7 PARES-TAMANHO RN # 0301071 - PIMPOLHO', size RN, stock 100. The description says '7 pares de meias um para cada dia da semana'. The API also shows the feminino #0301070 at R$30,56 with stock 100. This conforms to T01-13 'KIT MEIA SEMANINHA'. Composition is not on the page. In an Emilio search of about 100 sock products it is the cheapest 7-pair semaninha; the 00-15 and 16-20 versions cost R$32,90-33,99. The cost sits above T01-13's homologated R$16,00.

The listed page, re-read today, shows Price 4.63 for 'LUVINHA MALHA # 49 - LENE', described as 'malha suedine 100% algodão'. The BRANCO variant has stock 10, and the page does not mention an elastic cuff. A cheaper option that conforms better is on the same supplier, read today: 'KIT LUVA FEITA EM MALHA - 3 PARES # 116 - CASTELO' at Price 7.29 (variants MASCULINO/FEMININO/NEUTRO, stock 99999/100/99999), with 'Composição: Meia malha 100% Algodão. Acabamento 96% Algodão e 4% Elastano', i.e. a cotton knit with an elasticated cuff. 7.29/3 = R$2,43 per pair. That meets T11-8 ('100% algodão, com elástico nas pontas') better than the Lene, whose cuff is not stated. Caveats: (a) it means delivering one pair split from a 3-pair kit; (b) no white variant is named, so T33-6 ('cor branco') still needs the Lene BRANCO at R$4,63 or confirmation of the NEUTRO colour; (c) T38-7 (wool) needs e.g. Castelo 'LUVA DE LÃ - COM 3 UNIDADES # 112' at R$8,78 (acrylic), which I read only through the catalogue API. If single-pair packaging is required, the next option is the Lene at R$4,63 (elastic not stated) or Fio de Amor 'LUVINHA DE MALHA DELICATO # 300' at R$6,10, 100% algodão with a 'punho em ribana' cuff (read through the API).

The listed page, re-read today, shows Price 11.96 for 'KIT DE LUVAS 3 PARES - TAMANHO RN # 0750405405 - CONDE DUCK'. Only the FEMININO RN variant is listed, with stock 10, and the page says 'LUVAS: 60% ALGODÃO 39% POLIAMIDA 01% ELASTANO'. The price is right, but a clearly cheaper conforming kit is on the same supplier, read today: 'KIT LUVA FEITA EM MALHA - 3 PARES # 116 - CASTELO' at Price/ListPrice 7.29. It comes in MASCULINO/FEMININO/NEUTRO, size ÚNICO (newborn), stock 99999/100/99999, and is 'Meia malha 100% Algodão. Acabamento 96% Algodão e 4% Elastano'. It meets T01-17 'KIT LUVA C/3 PARES' and has more cotton than the Duck kit. That is 39% cheaper, and it is also below T01-17's homologated R$8,00.

checks.evidence: Re-read 2026-09-25. The page JSON has Price/ListPrice 2.49, measurementUnit CX, unitMultiplier 1, AvailableQuantity 99999, productName 'HASTES FLEXÍVEIS CREMER MINIONS - 75 UNIDADES # 410020 - CREMER'. The description says the tips are 100% cotton with antigerm treatment, and the stems are yellow. A box of 75 fits the 75-100 box basis for the lines that state no count (T11-5, T30-11, T35-4). The row's own caveat is correct: 75 fails T10-7, which asks for 100. For that line Emilio sells HASTES FLEXÍVEIS COTTON LINE 120 UNIDADES #000007 Higie-Topp at R$2,60 per CX (read today, plastic/cotton, https://www.emilio.com.br/hastes-flexiveis-cotton-line---120-unidades---000007---higie-topp/p). It is almost the same price and conforms to every line, so it could be the single SKU for this article.

Re-read 2026-09-25. Price/ListPrice 3.99, measurementUnit PC, unitMultiplier 1, in stock. The name is 'HASTES FLEXÍVEIS TOPZ - 150 UNIDADES # 410013 - CREMER' and the description reads only 'Hastes Flexíveis Topz Cremer com 150 unidades.' This is the cheapest 150-count bud in Emilio's catalogue search: the pote #410051 is R$5,99, pote #637601 R$6,90 and personagens pote R$6,90. Other retailers (Drogasil, Mercantil Atacado) list the Topz 150 as a 'caixa' with 100% cotton tips and a flexible plastic stem, so the box/plastic-stem reading is well supported. Double tips are still not written on the Emilio page itself.

Re-read 2026-09-25. The schema.org offer shows price 3.29, InStock. The product JSON shows 'price':3.29 and 'wholesalePrices':[{'minQuantity':2,'price':2.99}], totalStock 500, SKU 000000000000948494-UN. The title is 'Algodão Select Rolo 25g | Tenda Atacado'. R$2,99 from 2 units is correct. Notes: the page metadata gives the brand as 'Melitta', not Tenda own label. The description never says 'hidrófilo' (the row flags this). Tenda also sells 'Algodão Hidrófilo Rolo Select 50g' at R$6,49 in the search listing, which uses the word but is double the weight, so the 25 g roll remains the right basis. Tenda prices can vary by CEP.

Row price confirmed on 2026-09-25: Price/ListPrice 5.39, unit PC, name 'ALGODÃO BOLA DENGO - 100g # 8523 - MINASREY', and the description says 'Algodão Hidrófilo em Bola Dengo 100gr'. However, the same supplier (Emilio) sells 'ALGODÃO BOLAS - 100G # 9650 - SUSSEX' at Price/ListPrice 4.53 per PT, unitMultiplier 1, stock 99999. Its description reads 'composto de fibras 100% algodão, purificadas e alvejadas ... isentas de quaisquer impurezas'. Purified, bleached cotton is by definition hydrophilic cotton, and the weight (100 g) and form (balls) are the same. It is about 16% cheaper. Caveat: the Sussex page does not use the literal word 'hidrófilo'. If the buyer insists on that wording on the label, keep Dengo at R$5,39. This covers T31-17 only; T35-3 still needs its weight.

Re-read 2026-09-25. The page shows 'Por: R$ 1,30' and 'R$ 1,24 à vista com desconto'. GA4 value is 1.3. Specs: Pacote, 10 unidades por embalagem, 13 fios, 7,5 x 7,5cm, hidrófila, 100% algodão, estéril (óxido de etileno), 8 camadas. The related-product block lists 'Compressa de Gaze Estéril 13 fios 7,5x7,5 c/10 Kit 100Pcts Hérika' at R$104,00 (data-ga4-price 104.00), which is R$1,04 per pacote. The brand inconsistency is resolved on the page itself: 'Marca: Hérika (America Medical)', so Hérika is America Medical's brand. The seller is Cirúrgica Paulista Commerce Ltda, CNPJ 05.768.154/0001-41, Av. Tiradentes 1309, Marília SP. It conforms exactly to T17-5. The same site's Cremer equivalent costs R$2,40, so no cheaper conforming option was seen. The row's caveat about T35-9's R$13 estimate (possibly a larger pack) stands.

Re-read 2026-09-25. The title is 'Absorvente Pós-Parto Karisma C/ 45 unid Kit 3 Pacotes', code J2AV7NMFF, brand Adultcare, price R$ 45,00 (fbq value 45.00), Estoque Disponível. That is R$15,00 per pacote of 15. The related single 'Absorvente Pós-Parto Karisma C/15 unid' is R$ 15,50. The description says 'indicado para o pós parto, super absorvente e com formato muito mais anatômico ... fluxos intensos ... A embalagem contém 15 unidades.' The seller is Diniz Emporio Das Fraldas Ltda - ME, CNPJ 10.756.572/0001-59. It conforms to the article (dedicated post-partum, high flow, 15). Caveat carried from the row: pad length and width are still not published. A web search found only the package size (16x25x7 cm) and '3 linhas adesivas', so the ~35x13 cm in T42-16 is unverified. The R$15,00 rate needs a 3-pack purchase.

Price confirmed on 2026-09-25: 'Absorvente Geriátrico Security 50 unid', code MMJZA6GYC, R$ 28,00 (fbq value 28.00), Disponível. The related 'Security 200 unid Kit 4 pacotes' is R$108,00, which is R$27,00 per 50. Conformance to T16-11 is not shown. It is a geriatric pad, 'uso adulto e tem tamanho único', indicated 'para incontinência, pós parto e também para pós operatório'. The page mentions an impermeable layer and gel, but not anatomical shape, lateral leak barriers or adhesive fixing, all of which T16-11 requires. A web-search snippet (Amazon/Magalu, not read by me; Magalu returned 403) claims about 15x45 cm with flow channels and an anti-leak layer, but still no lateral barriers. No dedicated post-partum pad sold in a 50-pack was found. The 50-unit market is multi-use geriatric/pós-parto pads like this one, and T16-11's R$23,23 estimate fits that class. So R$28,00 (R$27,00 at the 4-pack rate) is a plausible cost only if the buyer accepts this pad, and it cannot be confirmed as conforming. The conforming fallback is the dedicated anatomical Karisma pós-parto pad at R$15,00/15 (kit rate, same supplier): about R$50,00 for 50 pads over 3.33 packs. That is not a single sealed pack of 50, so no corrected unit cost is banked.

If either gap is closed, that towel becomes TOO_DEAR evidence of about R$29. All other hooded towels under R$32.49 at Emilio that state a size are 94x70 or smaller, which fails the 100 cm length. The claimed evidence path is partly stale. /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products/62267 now returns 404 'ID de produto invalido', because the site has moved to a new frontend and the product id is now 66373. I read the product page itself on 2026-09-25 (it redirects to the URL without the trailing slash). Title: 'Fralda Turma da Monica Baby P44 M40 G32 XG26 XXG22'. The seller shown in the footer is 'Mensa Distribuidora Ltda - CNPJ 10.290.457/0001-31'. It conforms: the spec asks only for size P in a pack of 38 (T15-1 wrapper, no brand or features given), and 44 is 6 over.
